notes: The abstract states randomised group sizes of 132 (experimental) and 137 (control), but analyses included data from 246 children and were based on allocated treatment. The outcome-specific analysed denominators are 119 and 127; a full intention-to-treat outcome count is NOT_IN_PACKET. General diarrhoea is a separate outcome: nine of 119 (8%) versus 29 of 127 (23%). The window is stated for general diarrhoea; no separate antibiotic-associated diarrhoea assessment window or explicit study-end timepoint is stated.
